title: When greed keeps calling itself need in the day as it is
issueStatement: The appetite keeps expanding faster than contentment can breathe. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru exposes false wealth and redirects desire toward what actually travels with the soul. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor.
actionPrompt: Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.

source.shortMeaning: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating
source.lifeApplication: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

excerpts.explanation: The line names the pressure without melodrama: greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating.

source.shortMeaning: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord
source.lifeApplication: Invest in what crosses the threshold with you. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

excerpts.explanation: The turn is practical here. Invest in what crosses the threshold with you. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

source.shortMeaning: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again
source.lifeApplication: Comparison steadies when o Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth;. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.
